A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text and a white E in the black lower border, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-crashlanding-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Crash Landing (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 18 August 2019): The game text reads: “If you have a piloted AT-AT present at a site, target opponent’s non-creature vehicle present at same or adjacent exterior site. Draw destiny. If AT-AT has a vehicle weapon, add 1 to destiny draw. Target ‘crashes’ if total destiny > 3.”. This is a slip again: the lower part of the card with the white italic “E” in the black lower border; unlike the 2013 slip it prints no title. “non-creature” is hyphenated again, as in Decipher's errata, and the card type reads “USED INTERRUPT” (the 2013 slip printed “USE INTERRUPT”).

The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
